data.name: Springfield Hotel
data.detailed_description:
Springfield Hotel is a first-person social deduction horror survival video game. A bold blend of horror survival, traitor deduction and escape room, you and your group must solve puzzles to end the hotel’s curse while one player secretly sabotages your every move. Meanwhile, the Ghoul stalks the halls, taking a soul every 90 seconds. Who do you trust? And can you figure it out in time? Your survival depends on it.

Horror Survival + Traitor Deduction + Escape Room

A bold blend of horror survival, traitor deduction and escape room, you and your group must solve puzzles to end the hotel’s curse while one player secretly sabotages your every move. Meanwhile, the Ghoul stalks the halls, taking a soul every 90 seconds. Who do you trust? And can you figure it out in time? Your survival depends on it.

The Hotel Is Always Listening

In Springfield Hotel, making noise isn’t just inconsiderate, it’s lethal. Our Dynamic Terror Rank System decides who the Ghoul goes after next, turning every choice into a deadly game of risk and reward. Make too much noise, attract too many eyes, or meddle with what you don’t understand—and your rank rises. The Hotel remembers every mistake, and the Ghoul always comes for the one it notices most.

Will You Solve The Mystery In Time?

Vital clues and puzzles hide in the haunted halls. Mix cocktails that reveal hidden messages in the walls. Restore paintings that cry forgotten secrets. Tune antique radios until they play a tune that no soul should hear. Every task sheds layers of the hotel’s eerie past, revealing clues to the past and keys to escape.

The Doors Open...But Only For A Few

So you’ve completed the rituals. Survived the Harbinger and the Ghoul. Congratulations. Now fight your so-called friends for one of the few exit routes. When exits are revealed, there aren’t enough for all the survivors. Betrayal becomes your final path out. Become the monsters you feared or fall victim to them.

A Love Letter to Haunted Glamour

Every detail is dialed to a tragically beautiful setting. Step into a breathing 1930s environment lined with flaking gold, bloodstained velvet, and memories that should’ve stayed buried. With cinematic-quality visuals and rich character backstories, every game is a serialized horror short waiting to be retold on Discord. You’ll come for the screams and decor. You’ll stay because something locked the doors.

data.short_description: A social-deduction horror game set in a hotel that changes after dark. Blend in, uncover secrets, and survive the night. Trust is fragile, identities are hidden, and every night could be your last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 (6 GB VRAM) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror-themed violence, including scenes of character death and blood effects. Some environments and story elements may be disturbing or psychologically intense.
